src.quote: Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin was 31.8%.
Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin was 31.8%.
Google Services revenues increased 11% to $96.3 billion, led by 12% growth in Google Search & other with the year-over-year Search query growth rate the highest it has been in the last five years.
Google Services revenues increased 11% to $96.3 billion, led by 12% growth in Google Search & other with the year-over-year Search query growth rate the highest it has been in the last five years.

Google Cloud delivered record growth as revenues increased 103% to $30.7 billion, led by strong growth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI infrastructure and enterprise AI solutions, as well as core GCP services.
Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 25% to $127.6 billion, reflecting strong performance across the business and our 13th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.
Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 25% to $127.6 billion, reflecting strong performance across the business and our 13th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth.

Google Cloud delivered record growth as revenues increased 103% to $30.7 billion, led by strong growth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI infrastructure and enterprise AI solutions, as well as core GCP services.
Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin was 31.8%.
Net income available to common stockholders was $26.2 billion and EPS was $2.12.

notes.note: 原文同時列出 GOOG 與 GOOGL 兩個股票代號（NASDAQ: GOOG, GOOGL），ticker 填 GOOGL；如需改用 GOOG 請人工調整。
股數列沒有獨立單位說明，依損益表表頭「(In millions, except per share amounts, unaudited)」判定 share_unit 為 millions。
幣別原文只寫 $，填 USD。會計基準依原文「prepared and presented in accordance with GAAP」填 US GAAP。
損益表沒有毛利列，依規則 gross_profit 填 null（not_applicable）；銷管費用分開列示，sga_expense 填 null；沒有其他營業收益及費損列，other_operating_net 填 null。

依人工判斷，原文合計列「Total costs and expenses」（本季 87,001；去年同期 71,118）已包含 Cost of revenues，不是營業費用合計，原先填入會使營業成本被扣兩次；原文沒有不含營業成本的營業費用合計列，且不得自行計算，故 operating_expenses_total 改填 null（not_applicable）。原文營業利益＝Revenues − Total costs and expenses；營業費用各列（研發、銷售及行銷、一般及管理）已列在 operating_expense_items。
損益表沒有「attributable to」列，net_income_to_parent 與 net_income 相同並附同一出處。EPS 分子為 Net income available to common stockholders（已扣 Preferred stock dividends 298）。

新聞稿重點段落的淨利數字「Net income available to common stockholders was $26.2 billion」依原文明確屬歸屬普通股股東淨利，已對應 income_statement.net_income_to_common（26,170）。headline_figures 的 net_income 代號對應本期淨利（26,468），口徑不同，故未放入 headline_figures；圖卡淨利採哪一個口徑由出圖工具與公司規範決定。
損益表、現金流量表只有本季與去年同期兩個單季欄（另有 Year To Date 累計欄，未使用），沒有上一季欄，依規則 5-1 不到其他頁找，故 income_statement 與 cash_flow 主要欄位未填 prior_quarter。第 9 頁地區營收表本身含 Quarter Ended June 30, 2026 欄，僅用於 geographies 的 prior_quarter。

營收拆分有多層：Google Search & other＋YouTube ads＋Google Network＝Google advertising（82,012）；Google advertising＋Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices＝Google Services total（96,302）；Google Services total＋Google Cloud＋Other Bets＋Hedging gains (losses)＝Total revenues（127,577）。依規則 segments 放最細一層，Hedging gains (losses) 標為調節項目。

部門營業利益：Google Cloud 與 Other Bets 已填入各自的 operating_income。Google Services 營業利益（本季 39,157；去年同期 33,527）無法對應到最細層的子項目，未填入；未分攤的 Alphabet-level activities（本季 (7,655)；去年同期 (4,467)）只有營業利益、沒有營收，無法成為 segments 項目，亦未填入。出處：第 2 頁及第 7 頁 Segment Operating Results。
Google Services 營收 $96.3 billion 出現在重點段落，但 segments 依規則採最細層、沒有 google_services 這個 key，故未放入 headline_figures；其年增率 11% 以 other:google_services_revenue_yoy 列在 stated_metrics。

地區營收取自第 9 頁「Revenues by Geography」表的 As Reported 數字；Hedging gains (losses) 列在「Revenues, excluding hedging effect」小計之外，標為調節項目。geographies 的 prior_quarter 取自同頁第二張表（Comparison from the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026 to the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026）。

新聞稿沒有 Key Performance Metrics 段落；kpis 取第 2 頁 Supplemental Information 表中的 Total TAC 與 Number of employees。CEO 引言中的 Gemini app 用戶數（one billion users）、YouTube Music and Premium 訂閱數（surpassed 150 million, including trials）、模型 API 處理量（nearly 32 billion tokens per minute）出自引言而非營運指標段落，且為約略描述，未列入 kpis。
free_cash_flow_stated 取自第 8 頁 Non-GAAP 自由現金流調節表，該表只有 Q4 2025 至 Q3 2026 四季與 TTM，沒有去年同期（Q3 2025），故 prior_year 填 null（not_disclosed）。TTM 自由現金流為 19,747。

本季沒有新的股票回購授權；本季 Repurchases of stock 為 0。第 2 頁的「$27.6 billion remained available for future issuance under the ATM Program」是增資（ATM 發行新股）的剩餘額度，不是回購授權。本季發行普通股淨收入 12,371（現金流量表 Proceeds from issuance of common stock, net of costs）。
dividends_paid 取「Dividend payments on preferred and common stock」，同時包含特別股與普通股股利。第 2 頁另載 2026 年 10 月宣告的股利：普通股每股 $0.22、Series A／B 強制轉換特別股每股 $15.63，屬宣告金額，未填入。
公司沒有給下一季或全年財測，也沒有財測調整，省略 guidance_next 與 guidance_revisions。

公司沒有標示任何一次性或非經常性項目，notable_items 給空陣列。第 8 頁附註說明本季權益證券損失 $8.7 billion（表列 Gain (loss) on equity securities, net (8,664)）對所得稅、淨利及稀釋 EPS 的影響（$1.9 billion、$6.7 billion、$0.55），並說明投資價值波動未來可能持續影響業外損益，原文未標示為一次性項目，故未列入。
公司揭露的 Non-GAAP 指標只有自由現金流與固定匯率營收，沒有 Non-GAAP EPS、營業利益或淨利，省略 market_specific。
Alphabet 財年與日曆年相同，fiscal_period 填 FY2026Q3。
